# SWK Properties

> SWK Properties LLC is a RERA-licensed Dubai real estate brokerage (ORN 51517) on Sheikh Zayed Road. It advises buyers, investors, tenants and landlords on off-plan launches, ready homes, leasing and property management across the UAE.

## Key facts
- Legal name: SWK Properties LLC
- Licence: Dubai Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA) brokerage, Office Registration Number (ORN) 51517
- Office: Office No 54, 27th Floor, Al Saqr Business Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 56 433 0448
- Email: info@swkpropertiesuae.com
- Hours: Sun–Thu 9:00–19:00 · Sat 10:00–16:00 GST
- Coverage: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah and Umm Al Quwain
- Services: off-plan advisory, ready (secondary) sales, residential and commercial leasing, property management, mortgage introductions, Golden Visa property guidance
- Languages: English, Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Pashto, French

## Guides
- [All guides](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/guides)
- [Complete Guide to Buying Property in Dubai (Ready & Off-Plan)](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/guides/buying): Both UAE residents and non-resident foreign nationals can purchase 100% freehold property in designated Dubai zones. On top of the agreed purchase price, buyers should budget approximately 6% to 7.5% in upfront transaction costs—primarily the 4% Dubai Land Department (DLD) transfer/Oqood fee, DLD Trustee fee (AED 2,100–4,200), Title Deed issuance (AED 580), and 2% brokerage commission (+5% VAT) on secondary resales.
- [Complete Guide to Renting Property in Dubai (Ejari, Cheques & Tenant Rights)](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/guides/renting): Residential leases in Dubai are governed by RERA and must be registered in the official Ejari system. Tenants typically pay annual rent in 1 to 4 post-dated cheques, provide a refundable security deposit (5% unfurnished or 10% furnished), pay a 5% agency commission (+5% VAT), and activate DEWA utilities (AED 2,000 refundable deposit for apartments or AED 4,000 for villas).
- [Complete Guide to Selling Your Dubai Property](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/guides/selling): To legally market and sell a property in Dubai, the registered owner must sign RERA Form A with a licensed brokerage (maximum 3 brokerages at any one time) via the Dubai REST app so a DLD Trakheesi marketing permit and Madmoun QR code can be issued. Sellers typically pay the Developer NOC fee (AED 500–5,000), mortgage early-settlement fee if financed (up to 1% capped at AED 10,000), and agreed agency fee.
- [Dubai Real Estate Investment Guide (Net Yields, Payment Plans & Risk Controls)](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/guides/investing): Dubai residential real estate offers 0% annual property tax and 0% personal rental income tax in the UAE, with the UAE Dirham pegged to the US Dollar at 3.6725 AED/USD since 1997. However, disciplined investors always calculate Net Yield rather than Gross Yield—deducting annual RERA Mollak service charges, maintenance reserves, leasing fees, and vacancy buffers—and verify developer escrow compliance before committing capital.

## Services
- [Off-plan advisory](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/services/off-plan-advisory): Off-plan means buying a home before it is finished, usually in stages tied to construction. It can put you into a community early on a structured payment plan, but it also means you carry delivery risk. We help you read a launch the way a lender would: who is building it, what has been delivered before, where your money sits, and what happens if dates slip.
- [Buying & selling ready property](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/services/secondary-market): Ready property means you can see what you are buying, check the building, and often move or rent within weeks. Whether you are buying or selling, our job is to price realistically, negotiate on evidence, and keep the transfer moving through the Dubai Land Department without surprises.
- [Leasing & rental](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/services/leasing-rental): Most Dubai tenancies are yearly and registered through Ejari. For tenants we match you to buildings by commute, budget and lifestyle. For landlords we find a reliable tenant, set a sensible rent, and make sure the paperwork is right from day one.
- [Investment advisory](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/services/investment-advisory): A good investment starts with a clear objective: monthly income, long-term growth or residency. We model each option on realistic rents, service charges and holding costs, and we tell you when a launch does not stack up.
- [Property management](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/services/property-management): If you own in Dubai but do not live here, or simply do not want to chase maintenance and cheques, we manage the tenancy for you and report clearly on what happened and what it cost.
- [Mortgage assistance](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/services/mortgage-assistance): Mortgage rules for UAE residents and non-residents differ on loan-to-value and documentation. We introduce you to lending partners, compare terms side by side, and keep the application moving so it does not hold up your purchase.
- [Legal & documentation](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/services/legal-documentation): The paperwork behind a Dubai purchase is straightforward when someone explains it in order. We coordinate with legal partners so you understand what you sign and when.
- [Interior & fit-out](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/services/interior-fitout): A unit that is furnished well rents faster and holds its value. We scope the work against your budget and the likely tenant, then manage the contractors so you are not on site.

## Communities
- [Downtown Dubai](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/communities/downtown-dubai): Home to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall — the city's most iconic address.
- [Dubai Marina](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/communities/dubai-marina): Waterfront towers, yacht life, and one of Dubai's liveliest promenades.
- [Palm Jumeirah](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/communities/palm-jumeirah): The world-famous man-made island of beachfront villas and resorts.
- [Business Bay](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/communities/business-bay): Dubai's dynamic business hub on the canal, minutes from Downtown.
- [Dubai Hills Estate](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/communities/dubai-hills-estate): Master-planned green community around an 18-hole championship golf course.
- [Jumeirah Village Circle](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/communities/jvc): Family-friendly, high-yield community at the centre of New Dubai.
- [Dubai Creek Harbour](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/communities/dubai-creek-harbour): Waterfront masterplan facing the Ras Al Khor wildlife sanctuary.
- [Sheikh Zayed Road](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/communities/sheikh-zayed-road): Dubai's iconic business spine, lined with landmark towers and swift metro access to every district.

## Insights
- [How to read a developer's track record before you reserve](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/insights/read-a-developers-track-record): A launch brochure shows intent. A handed-over community shows what the developer actually does. Here is how to check the second before you commit to the first.
- [Escrow, Oqood and the off-plan paper trail](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/insights/escrow-oqood-and-the-offplan-paper-trail): Three pieces of paperwork protect most off-plan buyers in Dubai. Here is what each one is, what it does, and what to keep.
- [Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah: choose the emirate before the project](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/insights/dubai-abu-dhabi-or-sharjah): Developers such as Emaar, Aldar and Arada have made it possible to buy in three emirates from one conversation. The decision that matters comes first: which emirate fits your plan.
- [Read a payment plan like a cash-flow schedule](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/insights/payment-plans-as-cash-flow): A payment plan is a timetable of obligations. Turning it into your own cash-flow calendar shows whether it works before you sign.
- [Branded residences: what the name adds, and what it cannot](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/insights/branded-residences-what-the-name-adds): From Dorchester Collection on Palm Jumeirah to Mercedes-Benz in Downtown, the UAE has become a market for brand-named homes. Here is how to think about the premium.
- [Questions to ask at the sales gallery, and the answers that should worry you](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/insights/questions-for-the-sales-gallery): A sales gallery is built to make you feel good. These questions turn the visit into a fact-finding session.
- [Buying from abroad: a checklist for non-resident buyers](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/insights/buying-from-abroad-a-checklist): Many SWK clients buy from India, Pakistan, Russia and the UK without visiting first. This checklist covers what to line up before you transfer a dirham.
- [Off-plan or ready in Dubai? Start with the date you need the keys](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/insights/off-plan-vs-ready-2026): A practical comparison of cash flow, handover uncertainty and the checks to make before choosing a Dubai property.
- [Dubai property Golden Visa: questions to settle before you buy](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/insights/golden-visa-property-guide): Understand the property route, check mortgage documentation and separate a purchase decision from a residency application.
- [Comparing Dubai rental yields: five neighbourhoods, one honest worksheet](https://www.swkpropertiesuae.com/insights/best-communities-for-rental-yield): A practical way to compare JVC, Business Bay, Dubai Marina, Dubai Hills and Dubai South without relying on unsupported yield rankings.
